proposed_smallest_prerequisite: Under Countable Choice, an absolutely continuous real function on a compact interval whose derivative is zero almost everywhere is constant, proved by one finite Cousin partition and an outer-small open cover of the exceptional set.
axiom_accounting: CC-only outer regularity and standard measure/null-set rules; deterministic first-dyadic gauge; deterministic left-if-bad Cousin recursion; finite partition and finite coordinate combinations. No DC invocation and no independence/necessity claim.
